endpoints.name: list_emails
endpoints.label: 📥 List Emails (Inbox)
endpoints.description: List emails matching a search query.

query_params.q: Free‑text search term or Gmail search operators (e.g. 'is:unread', 'from:example@gmail.com').

notes: Returns a list of message IDs in the inbox.

endpoints.name: get_email
endpoints.label: 📧 Get Email Details
endpoints.description: Retrieve full details of a specific email.

path_params.messageId: The ID of the email message to retrieve.

notes: Returns headers, labels, and full content.

endpoints.name: get_thread
endpoints.label: 🧵 Get Email Thread
endpoints.description: Retrieve all messages in a thread.

path_params.threadId: The ID of the thread to retrieve.

notes: Returns all messages in the conversation.

endpoints.name: list_labels
endpoints.label: 🏷️ List Labels
endpoints.description: Get all Gmail labels for the user.
notes: Useful for categorizing or filtering messages.

endpoints.name: send_email
endpoints.label: ✉️ Send Email

body_params.raw: The entire email content, base64‑encoded (RFC 2822 format).

notes: Construct 'to', 'subject', 'body' headers and body before encoding.

endpoints.name: create_draft
endpoints.label: 📝 Create Draft
endpoints.description: Save an email as a draft.

body_params.message: An object containing a 'raw' field with the base64‑encoded email.

notes: Same format as sending, but saves instead of sending.

endpoints.name: send_draft
endpoints.label: 🚀 Send Draft

body_params.id: The ID of the draft to send.

notes: Draft ID comes from create_draft response.

endpoints.name: get_attachment
endpoints.label: 📎 Get Attachment
endpoints.description: Download an attachment from an email.

path_params.messageId: The ID of the email containing the attachment.
path_params.attachmentId: The ID of the attachment to download.

notes: Attachment ID comes from the message's body part metadata.

endpoints.name: delete_email
endpoints.label: 🗑️ Delete Email
endpoints.description: Move a specific email to Trash.

path_params.messageId: The ID of the email to delete.

notes: To permanently delete, append '?deleted=true' to the URL.

endpoints.name: modify_labels
endpoints.label: 🧹 Modify Labels
endpoints.description: Add or remove labels from an email.

path_params.messageId: The ID of the email whose labels you want to change.

body_params.addLabelIds: Array of label IDs to add (e.g. ['STARRED']).
body_params.removeLabelIds: Array of label IDs to remove (e.g. ['INBOX']).

notes: Labels like 'STARRED', 'IMPORTANT', etc., can be added or removed.
